summary: E2E tested new Supplier Recap feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass for GET /api/reports/supplier-recap covering (a) response shape {groups,total_items,total_suppliers,transaction_count}, (b) recursive check that NO price/cost_price/total_amount/subtotal/profit/unit_price/discount keys exist anywhere in response, (c) group schema strictly {supplier_id,supplier_name,items,total_quantity} and item schema strictly {product_name,variant,description,sku,quantity}, (d) totals consistency (sum(items.quantity)==total_quantity per group; total_items==sum groups; total_suppliers==len(groups)), (e) date filter narrows correctly (start=2000, end=2000 -> 0 txns), (f) aggregation matches manual sum from /api/transactions grouped by product.supplier_id. Frontend at /supplier-recap: nav-supplier-recap sidebar link works, page has data-testid supplier-recap-page, recap-range has exactly the 6 required options (Hari Ini, Kemarin, 7 Hari Terakhir, Bulan Ini, Bulan Lalu, Custom); Custom reveals recap-start & recap-end date inputs; recap-preview contains NO 'Rp' text and table headers are exactly ['#','Nama','Produk','Detail Produk','Jumlah']; one supplier group rendered (recap-group-aba929b2-...); recap-print adds 'printing-a4' body class then removes it (no errors); recap-export-jpg and recap-export-png trigger downloads with filename 'rekap-supplier-2026-09-02.jpg/.png' and success toast. Regression: Dashboard/POS/Products/Transactions nav still present and clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:769-836 supplier_recap correctly excludes all price fields; only product_name/variant/description/sku/quantity are surfaced. Good.

Date filter uses string comparison on created_at (q['created_at']['$gte'/'$lte']). Works because transactions store ISO-8601 strings that sort lexically; be aware this only stays correct while dates remain ISO strings — a Date-typed migration could silently break it.
Products/suppliers lookup loaded with limit 2000/500 via to_list; fine for current scale but a future concern for stores with >2000 SKUs (pagination or lookup pipeline recommended).

SupplierRecap.jsx client-side date range uses new Date(customEnd + 'T23:59:59').toISOString() which converts local time to UTC — a user in WIB selecting end=2026-01-31 will send 2026-01-31T16:59:59Z; matches expectations since server compares against stored ISO created_at, but note the timezone semantics for tests.
Minor: SupplierRecap.jsx has no loading spinner while first fetch is in flight (only text 'Memuat...'); acceptable but a skeleton would be nicer.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded transactions (18 in wide window, 1 supplier group 'Frozen Food Supplier', 29 total items).
